title: Balancing Safety and Optimality in Robot Path Planning: Algorithm and Metric
abstract: arXiv:2505.23197v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Path planning for autonomous robots faces a fundamental trade-off between path length and obstacle clearance. While existing algorithms typically prioritize a single objective, we introduce the Unified Path Planner (UPP), a graph-search algorithm that dynamically balances safety and optimality via adaptive heuristic weighting. UPP employs a local inverse-distance safety field and auto-tunes its parameters based on real-time search progress, achieving provable suboptimality bounds while maintaining superior clearance. To enable rigorous evaluation, we introduce the OptiSafe index, a normalized metric that quantifies the trade-off between safety and optimality. Extensive evaluation across 10 environments shows that UPP achieves a 0.94 OptiSafe score in cluttered environments, compared with 0.22-0.85 for existing methods, with only 0.5-1% path-length overhead in simulation and a 100% success rate. Hardware validation on TurtleBot

translated_title: 机器人路径规划中的安全性与最优性平衡：算法与度量
translated_abstract: 自主机器人的路径规划面临路径长度与障碍物间隙之间的基本权衡。虽然现有算法通常优先考虑单一目标，我们引入了统一路径规划器（UPP），一种通过自适应启发式加权动态平衡安全性和最优性的图搜索算法。UPP采用局部逆距离安全场，并根据实时搜索进度自动调整其参数，实现可证明的次优性界限，同时保持优越的间隙。为了进行严格评估，我们引入了OptiSafe指数，一种归一化度量，用于量化安全性与最优性之间的权衡。在10个环境中的广泛评估表明，UPP在杂乱环境中达到0.94的OptiSafe分数，而现有方法仅为0.22-0.85，在模拟中仅增加0.5-1%的路径长度开销，且成功率为100%。在TurtleBot上进行了硬件验证。
tldr: 本文提出统一路径规划器（UPP）和OptiSafe度量，通过自适应启发式加权动态平衡安全性与最优性，在杂乱环境中显著提升安全性能且保持路径效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Unified Path Planner (UPP) and OptiSafe metric, dynamically balancing safety and optimality via adaptive heuristic weighting, significantly improving safety in cluttered environments while maintaining path efficiency.
